_doc: Registered theme packs (P5-FEEL A4). Explicit list, not a directory scan, so pack discovery is deterministic and survives export filters. Each entry: id (matches the pack's theme.json id) and theme_path (res:// path to its theme.json). data/ui.json theme_path is the shipped default; UiStyle.set_theme(id) picks another listed pack for the current app session only (never saved). See docs/THEME_MAP.md.
